A whole ''valley''&hellip; untouched by the meteor bombardment that's obviously ''pasted'' the rest of the planet!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 50">[[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars'' (1977) 50]]</ref>}}
The '''Untouched Valley''' was a valley on the [[Planet of the Red Nebula]]. It remained untouched by the cataclysm that destroyed the rest of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
